name: Venjaramoodu

assessment.confirmed: Public map selection resolves to published Manikkal village. Point identify and exact parcel_gid lookup both work. The correctly village-scoped `/core/v2/map/export/geojson/010309` request returns bounded parcel polygons in EPSG:32643; a 100 m parent bbox and four 50 m quadrants produced identical 8 parcel IDs and geometries after deduplication. A 10 m bbox returned one row. Sanitized point, exact-ID and one-feature WGS84 export samples are retained.
assessment.viewport: A bounded viewport transport is verified through POST GeoJSON export at the selected locationCode path. The exporter ignores `limit`, so the adapter uses a conservative grid, local feature cap and byte cap; it validates/filter-intersects returned geometry to the requested WGS84 bbox. An off-village bbox currently returns HTTP 200 with an empty untyped body, so the adapter fails closed there instead of inferring absence. Exact-ID absence is available only from parsed [] on feature_info.
assessment.adapterDecision: Implement the bounded GeoJSON and exact-ID adapter with strict response validation, EPSG:32643-to-WGS84 conversion, a one-retry auth refresh, and fail-closed empty/invalid viewport responses. Do not use approximate pixel sampling or treat empty untyped response as absence.
assessment.runtimeVerification: The 0.005-degree enclosing default cell returned 220 polygons (153595-byte upstream response) and rendered 220 features in the browser. Smaller default cells exposed the provider empty-body behavior; those attempts are preserved in kerala-initial-grid.json. Four distinct local polygons were reread through a fresh adapter with matching geometry. POST /proposals/binding returned complete coverage with one parcel and site area 3520.20 m².

bootstrap.csrf: Read meta[name="_csrf"] and meta[name="_csrf_header"]; use the resulting token under the dynamically named header for selector requests and map selection. No values retained.
bootstrap.locationCode: GET /web/taluk/gid?districtId=<districtGid>, then GET /web/village/gid?talukId=<talukGid>&loadAllVillage=true&loadPublishedVillage=true; POST /web/ilms/map/view as application/x-www-form-urlencoded with districtGid/talukGid/villageGid. Response identifies locationCode 010309 and initdata.fgb_url with a temporary auth_key. Never persist key, CSRF or cookie values.

viewportTransportInvestigation.bundle: Official /assets/map-library-v3/bn-map.umd.js includes a FlatGeobuf HTTP Range reader that sends GET with Range: bytes=start-end. The official web_ilmsMapView_xyz.js uses click_info for point identify and feature_info/extent for attribute lookup; it does not contain a direct FGB or bbox parcel query. Current map-view output_layers uses LAND_PARCEL_LRM_STYLE image tiles and WMS layers; no active FGB layer was configured.
viewportTransportInvestigation.fgbUrl: Map-view response includes initdata.fgb_url at https://bhunaksha.entebhoomi.kerala.gov.in/bhunaksha_v5_emaps/core/v2/map/export/fgb/010309?<temporary-auth-key-omitted>. The viewer-issued URL and key were not written to disk or included here.

viewportTransportInvestigation.conclusion: The earlier parcel-code probes used the active INDIA_BOUNDARY exporter path `/core/v2/map/export/geojson/000000`; that path is scoped to the boundary layer and returned an empty body for substituted parcel codes. The selected viewer auth_key and actual village path `/core/v2/map/export/geojson/010309` are required. At that target path, the actual bounded GeoJSON request body with `map_type=GENERIC_MAP`, `layer_code=LAND_PARCEL`, `srs=EPSG:32643` and `bbox` returned 8 geometries; partitioning the 100 m bbox into four 50 m quadrants produced the identical deduplicated IDs and geometries. `limit` is ignored and is not treated as a completeness signal. The active WMS GetFeatureInfo test remains 404. FGB at `/fgb/010309` returned a bounded 3,392-byte payload with FGB magic despite an application/geo+json response header; GeoJSON is used by the adapter. Empty off-village GeoJSON currently produces no body, so no absent viewport result is claimed.

geojsonResponse.bboxSemantics: returned geometries intersect the requested 100m bbox and are not clipped to it

emptyCellCheck.interpretation: HTTP 200 with zero bytes/no content type is invalid and fail-closed; it is not treated as a complete empty result.

exactIdAbsence.interpretation: Valid exact lookup can establish absence only when it returns this parsed empty array; empty/untyped viewport exports remain errors.

canonicalIdentityRecommendation.namespace: Include locationCode 010309 in the canonical prefix because parcel_gid uniqueness across villages was not established.
canonicalIdentityRecommendation.geometry: WKT MULTIPOLYGON Z is in EPSG:32643; convert XY to WGS84 for runtime output after a bounded adapter is possible.

reuseAndTerms: The adapter uses the viewer-issued temporary key for bounded GeoJSON requests within its normal public map session, refreshing once on expiry. Keys, cookies and CSRF values stay only in memory. Provider terms are informational; ownership attributes are excluded.
sensitiveData: No CSRF token, session cookie, temporary auth key, or unrelated external API key is included.

landParcelRaster.renderer: image tile layer / raster; no active FGB vector layer in output_layers

geojsonVectorSource.response: HTTP 200 application/geo+json, 75,275 bytes, FeatureCollection with one feature and geometry; this is the configured India boundary, not cadastral data

activeLayerConfiguration.credentialHandling: All URLs above omit query strings. Live viewer auth_key and CSRF/session values were used in memory only and not retained.

adapterProtocol.bootstrap: Public cookie + dynamic CSRF map session; select fixed district/taluk/Manikkal IDs, validate location_code 010309, use viewer-issued temporary auth_key only in memory; on auth status refresh once and retry once. Fixed origins and paths, redirects rejected.
